answer_1.quote: We use the NewsQA summarization dataset for main results, as it tests language understanding without extra context. ... We also evaluate on the Arena Hard and HumanEval datasets.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text summaries, code snippets, and other language generation outputs evaluated per token (functional unit).

answer_2.quote: After evaluating multiple quality metrics, we adopt the reward model as a consistent quality evaluator for the model outputs across our experiments. Specifically, we use the open-source pretrained Skywork reward model.

answer_3.quote: We use the open-source pretrained Skywork reward model, which ranks highly on the RewardBench benchmark, to evaluate the output quality of generated responses.
